abilities.name: Seize Command
abilities.description: When you spend Influence to gain 1 or more Command Tokens, you may place 1 other player’s Control Token into your tactic pool instead of gaining 1 of those Command Tokens. You may only have 1 of each player’s Control Tokens in your tactic pool.

abilities.name: Borrowed Authority
abilities.description: ACTION: Return 1 player’s Control Token from your tactic pool and perform a tactical action in a non-home, non–Mecatol Rex system with no other player’s units, using a token from that player’s reinforcements.

faction_techs.name: Overlord Matrix
faction_techs.description: When you activate a system or a system containing your units is activated you may exhaust this card to treat 1 of your units as galvanized during this tactical action for each command token in your tactic pool.

faction_techs.name: Cognitive Parallax Engine
faction_techs.description: When you would spend a Command Token from your strategy pool, you may exhaust this card to instead spend a Command Token from your reinforcements.

agents.name: Viren Tolar - Shadowstealer
agents.description: At the end of a player’s turn, you may exhaust this card. That player may spend 1 Influence to gain 1 Command Token.

commanders.name: High Marshall Serisi - Arm of the Harbinger
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Have your command tokens in 4 different systems.]
commanders.description: When you gain 1 or more Command Tokens, gain 1 Commodity for each Command Token gained.

heroes.name: Ellar Liser - Impetus of Control
heroes.note: Echo of Subjugation - Harbinger of Chains
heroes.description: ACTION: Select up to 1 of each player’s Command Tokens on the game board. Return those tokens to their reinforcements; for each token removed this way, gain 1 Command Token and 1 Trade Good. Then purge this card.

promissory.name: The Usurper's Lease
promissory.description: When you would spend Influence to gain 1 or more Command Tokens. Increase the amount of Influence spent by the number of neighbors you have. Then, return this card to the Ardentia player.

flagship.name: Sovereign's Gavel
flagship.description: After you roll dice for a round of combat, you may spend 1 Command Token from your strategy pool to produce 2 additional hits.

mech.name: Iron Claw Division
mech.description: DEPLOY: During the Commit Ground Forces step in a system adjacent to or containing a planet you control, you may spend 3 Influence to commit 1 Mech and 1 Infantry from your reinforcements.

starting_fleet.name: Ardentia Starting Fleet
starting_fleet.description: 1 Carrier, 1 Cruiser, 1 Destroyer, 2 Fighters, 4 Infantry, 1 Space Dock, 1 PDS

breakthrough.name: Subjugate
breakthrough.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card and spend 3 Influence. Return 1 other player’s Command Token from the game board to its reinforcements, then perform a Tactical Action in a non-home system that contains no other player’s ships without using a command token.

abilities.name: Diplomatic Immunity
abilities.description: You do not have to spend a Command Token to use the secondary ability of the Diplomacy strategy card. Other players cannot place your tokens for the primary effect of Diplomacy.

abilities.name: Mandate of Presence
abilities.description: Once per action phase, when you perform a Strategic Action, select 1 player and 1 system that contains 1 or more of your units, no legendary planets, and no other player’s units. That player places 1 Command Token from their reinforcements in that system.

faction_techs.name: Bilateral Nexus
faction_techs.description: When you perform the primary effect of a strategy card, you may exhaust this card to perform the secondary effect of that strategy card without spending a Command Token.

faction_techs.name: Domestic Production Agreements
faction_techs.description: You may treat systems that contain Command Tokens as units with PRODUCTION equal to the number of Command Tokens in those systems.

agents.name: Seris Kael - Warden of Accord
agents.description: When a player returns a Promissory Note to its owner, exhaust this card. Those players each gain 1 Command Token and perform a transaction.

commanders.name: Velorine Nevorith - Keeper of Keys
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Have units in a system that contains 2 or more other players' command tokens.]
commanders.description: Increase the resource and influence values of planets in systems that contain other players’ Command Tokens by 1.

heroes.name: Aranth Vel - The Everbinding
heroes.note: Pact Sunt Servanda - For the Greater Good
heroes.description: ACTION: For each other player, place 1 Command Token in a system that contains 1 or more of your units and no other player’s Command Tokens. Then, purge this card.

promissory.name: Pact Renewed
promissory.description: When you perform the primary effect of a strategy card, you may place this card face up in your play area. Perform the secondary effect of that strategy card without spending a command token. At the start of the Status Phase, return this card to the Verydith player.

flagship.name: Concordia's Voice
flagship.description: Non-fighter ships in this system roll 1 additional combat die if this system contains another player’s Command Token.

mech.name: Pactforged Sentinel
mech.description: Other players must spend 1 Influence or destroy 1 unit they control to return a Command Token from a system that contains exactly 1 of your Mechs to their reinforcements.

starting_fleet.name: Verydith Starting Fleet
starting_fleet.description: 1 Carrier, 1 Cruiser, 1 Dreadnought, 3 Fighters, 4 Infantry, 1 Space Dock

breakthrough.name: Unyielding Accord
breakthrough.description: When one or more other players place a Command Token in a system that contains 1 or more planets you control, ready 1 planet in that system and explore it.

abilities.name: Lobbyist Dues
abilities.description: During the Agenda Phase, if an outcome that you voted for or predicted is not resolved, gain Commodities equal to the number of players who voted for the outcome that was resolved.

abilities.name: Tight Scheduling
abilities.description: After the first agenda is revealed, draw 3 agendas and place them in your hand. When an agenda would be revealed, you may reveal 1 agenda from your hand instead. At the end of the Agenda Phase, place the remaining agendas on the bottom of the deck in any order.

faction_techs.name: Klepotcratic Politics
faction_techs.description: After an agenda is revealed, you may exhaust this card and predict aloud the outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, perform the secondary ability of a strategy card without spending a Command Token.

faction_techs.name: Inner Sanctum
faction_techs.description:
Gain the Inner Sanctum planet card and its legendary planet ability card. You cannot lose these cards, and this card cannot have an X or Y assimilator token placed on it.

Inner Sanctum — 0 Resources / 3 Influence

After an agenda is revealed, you may exhaust this card and predict aloud the outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, each player who voted for the resolved outcome draws 1 action card.

agents.name: Orrin Malvek - Deacon of Taxes and Prayer
agents.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card. Draw 1 action card and look at the top agenda. Place it on the top or bottom of the agenda deck.

commanders.name: Cyrala Vey - Bishop of Law and Scripture
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: At the start of the agenda phase, exhaust all but 3 planets you control.]
commanders.description: After an agenda is resolved, if the outcome you voted for is not resolved, produce 1 ship in a system that contains your ships with cost less than the votes you cast.

heroes.name: Speaker Gilbrand - Cardinal of Governance and Faith
heroes.note: Adoration of the Masses - Thousandfold Council
heroes.description: When an agenda outcome you voted or predicted for is resolved, draw 1 action card. When an agenda outcome you voted or predicted for is not resolved, gain 1 Command Token.

promissory.name: Hand of the Synod
promissory.description: ACTION: Discard up to 1 action card and draw that many action cards + 1. At the start of the Status Phase, return this card to the Veylor player.

flagship.name: Silent Edict
flagship.description: At the end of a round of space combat involving this unit, you may discard 1 action card to assign 1 hit to a non-carrier ship in this system.

mech.name: Vox Sentinels
mech.description: When you exhaust this unit’s planet to vote, cast 2 additional votes.

starting_fleet.name: Veylor Starting Fleet
starting_fleet.description: 2 Carriers, 1 Cruiser, 3 Fighters, 3 Infantry, 1 Space Dock

breakthrough.name: Filibustered Legislation
breakthrough.description: When an agenda is resolved, you may exhaust this card. That agenda is resolved with no effect. Each player may ready 1 planet they control. Vote on 1 additional agenda during the Agenda Phase this effect is used.

abilities.name: Factory Lease
abilities.description:
During setup, gain the Factory Lease promissory notes.

At the start of the Agenda Phase, you may produce 1 unit other than a war sun in a system containing 1 of your space docks and no other players ships for each Factory Lease attachment on the game board.

abilities.name: Echo of the Anvil
abilities.description: When you produce 2 or more units, reduce the combined cost by 1 if you produced at least 2 units of the same type.

faction_techs.name: Replicator I
faction_techs.description: This unit can only produce Dreadnoughts or units of the same type as those it is transporting.

faction_techs.name: Replicator II
faction_techs.description:
This unit cannot be destroyed by Direct Hit action cards.

This unit can only produce Dreadnoughts or units of the same type as those it is transporting.

faction_techs.name: Segmented Structuring
faction_techs.description: After movement, you may remove any number of your non-flagship ships from the active system. Place a number of units up to the combined PRODUCTION value of your units in that system whose combined cost is equal to or less than the removed units.

agents.name: Kelron Dross - Ember-Sword
agents.description: When a player activates a non-home system, exhaust this card. That player may destroy 1 non-fighter ship with a cost less than 4. That system gains PRODUCTION equal to that unit’s cost +2.

commanders.name: Thessa Scale - Ash-Plate
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Have 4 or more non-fighter ships of the same type in the same system.]
commanders.description: When you place a structure from your reinforcements on a planet you control, draw 2 action cards and discard 1.

heroes.name: Orun Slag - The Eternal Forge-Hammer
heroes.note: Sledge of the Master - Factory World Mass Production
heroes.description: ACTION: Remove any number of your units from the board and place them in systems that contain a planet you control and no other player’s ships. Then purge this card.

promissory.name: Factory Lease: Cultural
promissory.description: At the end of your turn, attach this card to a cultural planet you control. That planet gains PRODUCTION equal to its influence value.

promissory.name: Factory Lease: Hazardous
promissory.description: At the end of your turn, attach this card to a hazardous planet you control. That planet gains PRODUCTION equal to its resource value.

promissory.name: Factory Lease: Industrial
promissory.description: At the end of your turn, attach this card to an industrial planet you control. That planet gains PRODUCTION equal to the number of planets in this system.

flagship.name: Hammer of Silence
flagship.description: This unit’s PRODUCTION equals the resource value of 1 planet you control in this unit’s system.

mech.name: Ironbound Guardian
mech.description: DEPLOY: After movement, you may remove 2 of your Fighters or Infantry from the space area of the active system to place 1 Mech from reinforcements with your units in the active system.

starting_fleet.name: Myrr Starting Fleet
starting_fleet.description: 1 Cruiser, 2 Dreadnoughts, 6 Fighters, 2 Infantry, 1 Space Dock, 1 PDS

breakthrough.name: Remote Workforce
breakthrough.description: When you use PRODUCTION on 1 or more units, you may exhaust this card to resolve the PRODUCTION abilities of each unit you control in another system. Increase the combined PRODUCTION of those units by 2 and reduce the combined cost of those units by 1.

abilities.name: Expeditionary Cache
abilities.description: When you gain 1 or more Commodities, you may spend any number of Commodities to place Expedition Tokens on planets, up to the number of Commodities spent.

abilities.name: Shared Discoveries
abilities.description: At the end of a player's Tactical Action, you may remove 1 Expedition Token from a planet the active player controls in that system to allow them to explore that planet twice as if it were each of two traits.

abilities.name: Colony Outposts
abilities.description: After you explore a planet that contains 1 of your structures you may spend 1 command token to reveal exploration cards for that planet's trait until you reveal a structure. Resolve that exploration card and shuffle the rest back into that deck.

flagship.name: Vaultbreaker
flagship.description: When you gain control of a planet in this unit's system, gain 1 Commodity.

mech.name: Excavator
mech.description: Once per action, at the end of a tactical action, if a planet in the active system contains exactly 2 of your Mechs, you may explore that planet.

faction_techs.name: Surveyor's Lens
faction_techs.description: At the end of a tactical action, you may exhaust this card to explore 1 non-home, non-legendary planet in the active system. When you gain a relic fragment during exploration, you may remove 1 Infantry from the explored planet to ready this card.

faction_techs.name: Trait Harmonizer
faction_techs.description: Increase your Commodity value by 1 for each different planet trait you control.

promissory.name: Archaeologist Outpost
promissory.description: ACTION: Attach this card to 1 non-home planet you control and return units on that planet to the space area of that system. This planet is treated as a station.

agents.name: Draven Callas - Rummager of Relics
agents.description: At the start of a player's turn, you may exhaust this card. Place 1 exploration card that matches a planet that player controls from its discard pile on top of its respective deck.

commanders.name: Serel Venn - Bounding Cartographer
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Have 2 cards from different exploration decks in your play area.]
commanders.description: At the start of the Strategy Phase, choose 1 non-home, non-legendary planet. Explore that planet as if it were any trait.

heroes.name: Zairos CVI - Explorer Extraordinaire
heroes.description: ACTION: Shuffle 5 purged exploration cards that do not place tokens on the game board on top of their respective exploration decks. Then explore up to 5 planets you control. Then purge this card.

starting_fleet.name: Kairn Starting Fleet
starting_fleet.description: 2 Dreadnoughts, 2 Fighters, 2 Infantry, 2 Mechs, 2 Space Docks

breakthrough.name: Relic Trading Hub
breakthrough.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card and purge 1 relic fragment. Explore 1 planet with the same trait as that purged relic fragment and gain 2 purged fragments of any other color, if able.

abilities.name: Battle-Tested Designs
abilities.description: When you research a unit upgrade technology, you may exhaust 1 planet you control to ignore 1 prerequisite of that technology. Then, you may produce 1 unit of that type in a system that contains your units and no other players' ships, reducing its cost by 1.

abilities.name: Evolved Warforms
abilities.description: Your Mechs are treated as both ships and ground forces and gain Move 1. Mechs not being transported count against fleet capacity.

abilities.name: Testing Yard
abilities.description: One ship of each type in your home system does not count against fleet capacity.

faction_techs.name: Ultimate Evolution II
faction_techs.description: When you research or gain a technology, you may flip this card instead.

faction_techs.name: Ultimate Evolution III
faction_techs.description: When this unit uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE, cancel an additional hit.

faction_techs.name: Warspawn Juggernaut II
faction_techs.description: When you research or gain a technology, you may flip this card instead.

faction_techs.name: Warspawn Juggernaut III
faction_techs.description: When this unit produces a hit you may damage this unit to place infantry with this unit up to the number of hits produced.

promissory.name: Evolutionary Edict
promissory.description: When you research a unit upgrade, produce 1 of those units in your home system. Reduce its cost by the number of its prerequisites. At the start of the Kryxos player's turn, return this card to the Kryxos player.

agents.name: Dravok Veyl - Warshaper
agents.description: ACTION: Select 1 player and exhaust this card. That player may return 1 technology they own to research 1 unit upgrade technology.

commanders.name: Seraxis Thule - Battle Genealogist
commanders.description: Apply +1 to the combat and unit-ability rolls of units you own the unit upgrade technology for.

heroes.name: Zorath Ultimus - Evolution Incarnate
heroes.description: ACTION: Select 1 unit upgrade you own. For each prerequisite on it, research 1 technology. Then purge this card.

starting_fleet.name: Kryxos Starting Fleeet
starting_fleet.description: 1 Dreadnought, 1 Carrier, 1 Cruiser, 1 Destroyer, 1 Mech, 1 Fighter, 1 Infantry, 1 Space Dock, 1 PDS

breakthrough.name: Prototype Innovators
breakthrough.description: During each round of combat, or when you would roll dice for a unit ability, you may treat up to 3 units you control that own the unit upgrade technology as if they were galvanized.

abilities.name: Ritual of Ascension
abilities.description: ACTION: Purge 2 relic fragments to research 1 technology.

abilities.name: Primordial Secrets
abilities.description: During setup, select 1 Primordial Technology to play with. You have 1 additional faction technology.

abilities.name: Forbidden Knowledge
abilities.description: Primordial technologies have no ability text unless the player using their effect has 4 other technologies of that color.

flagship.name: The Astral Codex
flagship.description: At the start of combat in this system, select 1 color of technology. This unit rolls additional combat dice equal to the number of technologies you own in that color.

mech.name: Rune-Bound Sentinel
mech.description: When you gain a technology, you may place 1 infantry on a planet containing 1 or more of your mechs for each prerequisite on that technology + 1.

faction_techs.name: Sigil of Transmutation
faction_techs.description: This technology may be treated as either a Warfare or a Cybernetic Technology. When you move ships into a non-home system you may exhaust this card, that system gains SPACE CANNON 5 (x3) and PRODUCTION 3 as if it were a unit until the end of that tactical action.

faction_techs.name: Seal of Revelation
faction_techs.description: This technology may be treated as either a Biotic or Propulsion Technology. ACTION: Exhaust this card to shuffle up to 1 purged exploration card that does not place a token on the game board into its respective deck. Then, explore a planet you control.

faction_techs.name: Power Word: Disintegrate
faction_techs.description: At the start of a combat involving your units, you may produce one hit against your opponent's units. At the start of a combat involving your units, you may exhaust this card to destroy a unit involved in that combat.

faction_techs.name: Power Word: Miracle
faction_techs.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card and do each of the following: Discard 1 action card and draw 2 action cards; Gain 1 command token; Place up to 4 infantry on planets you control.

faction_techs.name: Power Word: Plane Shift
faction_techs.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card to perform a tactical action in a system that either contains no planets or is an anomaly without spending a Command Token. Ignore the effects of anomalies and apply +1 to the movement value of each of your ships during this tactical action.

faction_techs.name: Power Word: Fabricate
faction_techs.description: When you gain this technology, place the Fabricate Station Token in a system that contains 1 of your ships.

promissory.name: Scroll of Ascension
promissory.description: At the start of the strategy phase: Research 1 non-unit upgrade, non-faction technology the Arcanum player does not own. If you do, the Arcanum player may spend 1 command token from their strategy pool to gain that technology. Then, return this card to the Arcanum player.

agents.name: Veyla the Keeper - Custodian of Tomes
agents.description: When a player gains a technology you may exhaust this card to allow that player to return that technology to their deck. They may gain 1 other technology with a number of prerequisites up to that returned technologies prerequisites + 1.

commanders.name: Orthis Lithon - Rune-Smith
commanders.description: When you exhaust a technology you may place 1 fighter in a system that contains 1 or more of your ships.

heroes.name: Xirath Centious - The Eternal Sage
heroes.description: ACTION: Return up to 6 technologies you own to the deck. Gain purged relic fragments equal to the number returned then purge this card.

starting_techs.name: Arcanum Starting Tech
starting_techs.note: Choose 2 technologies in the same color with no prerequisites

starting_fleet.name: Arcanum Starting Fleet
starting_fleet.description: 1 Carrier, 2 Destroyers, 3 Fighters, 4 Infantry, 1 Space Dock, 1 PDS

breakthrough.name: Power Word: Wish (B<>R)
breakthrough.description: When you research a propulsion or warfare technology you may flip this card over. When you activate a system you may apply +1 to the move value of 1 of those units and +2 to the combat value of 2 units you control during that tactical action.

breakthrough.name: Power Word: Wish (Y<>G)
breakthrough.description: When you research a cybernetic or biotic technology you may flip this card over. When you activate a system apply +1 to the capacity value of 2 units until the end of that tactical action. When you use PRODUCTION apply -1 to the combined cost of those produced units.

abilities.name: Sting of the Hive
abilities.description: When you produce a hit with a unit ability, you may place 1 Mine Token in the active system instead. After movement, if the active system contains 1 or more Mine Tokens, remove any number of those tokens to either gain 1 Commodity or produce hits on the active player's units up to the number of tokens removed.

abilities.name: Hive Echo
abilities.description: During SPACE CANNON OFFENSE, a unit with SPACE CANNON up to 2 systems away may use it against units in the active system. During BOMBARDMENT and ANTIFIGHTER BARRAGE steps, if the active system contains 1 of your ships, a unit with that unit ability up to 2 systems away may use it against units in the active system.

flagship.name: Queen's Fang
flagship.description: This unit rolls extra combat and unit ability dice equal to the number of ground forces it is transporting.

mech.name: Hexan Stingers
mech.description: DEPLOY: After a player moves ships, if the active system contains a planet you control, pay 2 Trade Goods to replace 1 of your Infantry in that system with 1 Mech from reinforcements.

faction_techs.name: Biomechanical Nutrients
faction_techs.description: When you produce two or more hits with a unit ability you may place 1 ship in a system that contains your ships with a cost less than the number of hits produced.

promissory.name: Swarm Spawn
promissory.description: When you produce hits with a unit ability against your opponent's units, place this card face up in your play area. You may place Fighters in a system containing 1 of your ships equal to the number of hits produced. Then return this card to the Xytheris player.

agents.name: Myrix the Wax-Sealed
agents.description: When a player activates a system, you may exhaust this card. That player selects 1 non-fighter ship; it gains a Capacity and PRODUCTION value equal to the number of unit abilities it has during that tactical action. If it has those values, increase them by that amount instead.

commanders.name: Zythrix - Leader of the Endless Swarm
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Produce 3 or more hits with a unit ability.]
commanders.description: When you produce 1 or more hits with a unit ability, produce 1 additional hit.

heroes.name: Xyra the Venom-Queen
heroes.note: Call of the Queen - The Endless Swarm.
heroes.description: ACTION: Place this card near the game board. Once per action, when you would roll dice for a unit ability, apply +4 to those dice. Purge this card at the end of the round.

starting_fleet.name: Xytheris Starting Fleet
starting_fleet.description: 1 Carrier, 1 Cruiser, 1 Destroyer, 6 Infantry, 1 Space Dock, 2 PDS

breakthrough.name: Royal Rail Gun
breakthrough.description: If you own a PDS Unit Upgrade Technology flip this card over and place it in your play area. Your PDS units gain the following ability text and adjust their printed values by the indicated amounts. If they do not have those values, they gain them. Back Side Effect: This unit is also a ground force and a ship and may be transported in a ship with capacity. Stats: Combat 7, Planetary Shield, Sustain Damage.

abilities.name: Ignorant Discoveries
abilities.description: At the end of the Action Phase, you may purge 1 technology and spend 1 Command Token from your Strategy Pool to research 2 technologies.

abilities.name: Reflections of the Void
abilities.description: When you move units into a system with no planets, you may place 1 Reflection Token in a system that contains 1 or more planets you control. At the end of a Tactical Action in a system that contains 1 or more Reflection Tokens, you may purge 1 of those tokens to explore the frontier deck in that system.

flagship.name: The Obsidian Mirror
flagship.description: If this unit's system contains no planets you may treat this unit's system as adjacent to all non-fracture systems that contain no planets. During Movement this ship may move before or after your other ships.

mech.name: Acolyte of the Hollow
mech.description: During the Action Phase, if you purge 1 or more components, place 1 Infantry with this unit.

faction_techs.name: Oblivion Cannon
faction_techs.description: At the end of a round of space combat, you may purge 1 non-fighter ship you control in that system with a cost of 4 or less. Produce and assign hits equal to half its cost (rounded up) against your opponent's units in that system.

faction_techs.name: Mirrored Memories
faction_techs.description: ACTION: Play 1 action card with a component action from the discard pile and exhaust this card. Purge that action card instead of discarding it.

promissory.name: Shard of Nothingness
promissory.description: ACTION: Draw 3 unused red-backed system tiles. Choose 1 and place it adjacent to 2 systems. If it contains no planets, place a frontier token in that system. Then purge this card and the unchosen tiles.

agents.name: Avaris the Darkseer
agents.description: At the start of a player's turn, you may exhaust this card. Place 1 frontier token in a system with no planets. Then look at the top card of the frontier deck and place it on top of its deck or discard it.

commanders.name: Deyra the Voidborn
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Have units in 3 systems adjacent to a system that contains no planets.]
commanders.description: When you purge 1 or more components, you may produce 1 unit with a cost of 4 or less in a system that contains 1 of your ships. Reduce its cost by 1.

heroes.name: Nothi the Frontiersman - Abyssal Artistry
heroes.description: ACTION: Draw 2 unused red-backed tiles and 2 unused blue-backed tiles. Choose 1 of each and purge the others. Place those tiles on the edge of the game board adjacent to 2 systems and a frontier token in each system that contains no planets. Then purge this card.

starting_fleet.name: Oblivion Starting Fleet
starting_fleet.description: 1 Carrier, 2 Cruisers, 1 Fighter, 2 Infantry, 2 Mechs, 1 Space Dock

breakthrough.name: Call of the Void
breakthrough.description: When you gain this breakthrough, draw red-backed system tiles equal to the number of players. Starting with you and proceeding clockwise, each player places 1 tile so that it is adjacent to at least 2 other tiles. Place a frontier token in each of those systems that contains no planets. When you explore the frontier deck, draw the top 2 cards of that deck, choose 1 to resolve, and discard the other.

abilities.name: Call of the Haunted
abilities.description: During setup, select 1 Revenant Pantheon Leader Set to play with. You have 1 additional leader of each type (Agent, Commander, Hero).

abilities.name: Commanding Presence
abilities.description: When you unlock or purge a leader for its effect, gain 1 Command Token.

abilities.name: Allure of Darkness
abilities.description: At the end of the strategy phase choose 1 other player's commander that does not have the Lich Token on it and place the Lich Token on it.

flagship.name: Reliquary Eternal
flagship.description: This unit rolls a number of additional dice equal to the number of unlocked, unexhausted, and unpurged leader types in your play area.

mech.name: Grave Robbers
mech.description: DEPLOY: When you exhaust an agent, or unlock/purge a leader, place 1 mech on a planet you control.

faction_techs.name: Lazarus Pods
faction_techs.description: When you exhaust an Agent for its effect or a player purges a Hero for its effect, you may produce 2 units in a system that contains 1 of your ships.

faction_techs.name: Eternal Aegis
faction_techs.description: During the first round of combat, you may cancel hits equal to the number of leader types you have unlocked, unexhausted, and unpurged.

promissory.name: Revenant Alliance
promissory.description: When you receive this card and you are not the Revenant Glory player, place it face up in your play area. While this card is in your play area, you may use the Pantheon Commander ability of the Revenant Glory player, if it is unlocked. If you activate a system that contains 1 or more Revenant Glory units, return this card to the Revenant Glory player.

agents.name: Xythis the Whispering Mask - The Gravetender Eternal
agents.description: Once per action, when a player exhausts a technology, exhaust this card to ready that technology.

agents.name: Zexan Myrix - Revenant of Xytheris
agents.description: After a system is activated you may exhaust this card and choose 1 player. Apply +1 to the combat rolls of that player's units during that tactical action.

agents.name: Runebearer Lothos - Revenant of the Arcanum
agents.description: When a player explores a planet they control: You may exhaust this card to allow that player to explore that planet as if it were any trait. If you choose another player, draw an action card.

agents.name: Koral Vel - Revenant of Verydith
agents.description: At the start of a player's turn: You may exhaust this card, that player may produce 1 unit in a system that contains 1 or more of their ships.

commanders.name: Ashara of the Silent Choir - Duke of the Necromancer
commanders.description: This commander has the ability text of each commander of the player with the lich token.

commanders.name: Melloh Terras - Revenant of Ponthous
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Have 3 units with SUSTAIN DAMAGE on the game board.]
commanders.description: Once per combat round, when 1 or more of your units use SUSTAIN DAMAGE, you may produce 1 hit against your opponent's units in that combat.

commanders.name: Arlir Mirrored - Revenant of Oblivion
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Control a planet of each planet trait.]
commanders.description: When you explore a planet that controls 1 of your structures you may draw an additional card. Choose 1 to resolve & discard the rest.

commanders.name: DOMI.N.O - Revenant of Myrr
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Produce 2 or more units of each of 2 different unit types at the same time.]
commanders.description: Once per action, when you produce 1 or more fighters or infantry, place 1 additional fighter or infantry in that system.

heroes.name: The Nameless Host - Revenant of Many
heroes.description: ACTION: Randomly draw 3 Heroes from among the unused Heroes. Add 1 to your play area unlocked. Then purge this card and those unchosen heroes.

heroes.name: Pryxos XIV - Revenant of Kryxos
heroes.description: At the start of a round of space combat, research 1 technology matching a unit you control in the active system and 1 technology matching a unit your opponent controls in the active system. Then purge this card.

heroes.name: Zairos the First - Revenant of Kairn
heroes.note: Call of the Frontier - Home of the Fallen
heroes.description: ACTION: For each exploration deck, you may shuffle 1 card from its discard pile into its deck. Then explore a planet of each trait you control. Then purge this card.

heroes.name: Lost Throne of Pride - Revenant of Ruin
heroes.note: Lost Throne of Pride - Fallen King
heroes.description: At any time, you may treat a system that contains 1 or more of your units as if it had PRODUCTION 4 until the end of this action and immediately use that PRODUCTION ability. Then purge this card.

starting_techs.name: Revenant Starting Tech
starting_techs.note: 2 technologies in different colors with 1 total prerequisite

breakthrough.name: Revenant Rising
breakthrough.description: When you exhaust an Agent, do 1 of the following. When you purge a Hero, do all 3: Draw 1 Action Card; Explore 1 planet you control; Place 1 Mech on a planet you control.

abilities.name: Thrones of Ruin
abilities.description: During setup, select 2 Throne legendary planets and place them in your home system.

abilities.name: Traces of Ruin
abilities.description: Systems that contain Throne planets are anomalies. Players may score even if they do not control the throne planets in their home system.

flagship.name: The Sepulchral Crown
flagship.description: This unit's system is always treated as an anomaly.

mech.name: Ghola
mech.description: When 1 or more dice are rolled, you may destroy this unit to increase the value of 1 die by 3.

faction_techs.name: Rift-Touched Bastion
faction_techs.description: When a player activates a system that contains your units, you may exhaust this card and choose 1 system that contains your units. Treat the chosen system as if it has a Gravity Rift until the end of that activation.

faction_techs.name: Specter's Step
faction_techs.description: At the end of a Tactical Action, you may exhaust this card to move 1 of your ships from the active system to an adjacent system that: contains 1 or more of your units and contains no other players' ships.

promissory.name: Thronebound Covenant
promissory.description: ACTION: Place an unused Throne planet into your home system, and gain control of it. Then purge this Promissory Note.

agents.name: Malrik the Defiler - Keeper of Ashes
agents.description: When a unit is destroyed, exhaust this card. That player may place that unit in a system that contains 1 of their Space Docks and no other players' units.

commanders.name: Veythros the Shattered - Thrall of the Rift
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Have units in 3 systems that contain or are adjacent to anomalies.]
commanders.description: You may ignore the effects of each anomaly.

heroes.name: Seraphane the Eternal - Bearer of Thrones
heroes.description: ACTION: Place an unused Throne planet into your home system and gain control of it. Ready each planet in your home system. Then purge this card.

starting_fleet.name: Thrones Starting Fleet
starting_fleet.description: 1 Dreadnought, 1 Carrier, 5 Fighters, 1 Mech, 2 Infantry, 1 Space Dock

breakthrough.name: Lost Throne
breakthrough.description: When you gain this breakthrough, place the Aurelion station token in a system that contains a planet you control. Gain control of and ready it. Then flip this card. The Aurelion station token is also a ship that can be produced, counts against fleet pool, and participates in space combat in its system. Stats: Cost 6, Combat 7 (x2), Move 1, Bombardment 5 (x2), Sustain Damage. Aurelion — 1 Resource / 1 Influence (Station). Legendary Ability — Throne of Pride: This station's system is treated as an Entropic Scar, this anomaly does not prevent players from using unit abilities in its system.

abilities.name: Cycle of Reclamation
abilities.description:
During setup, place the moon phase cards in your play area.

When 1 or more units are destroyed in a system containing or adjacent to a system containing your units except during a combat on your tactical actions, capture 1 neutral destroyer.

abilities.name: New Moon
abilities.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card to do 1 of the following: Place 1 captured neutral unit into a system that contains no other player's ships. Capture 1 neutral cruiser.

abilities.name: Waxing Moon
abilities.description: At the start of your turn: You may exhaust this card. Return captured neutral units with a combined cost of 2 or more to draw 2 action cards, then discard 1.

abilities.name: Full Moon
abilities.description: At the end of your turn: You may exhaust this card. Return captured neutral units with a combined cost of 3 or more to place 1 structure on a planet you control.

abilities.name: Waning Moon
abilities.description: When you pass: You may exhaust this card. Return captured neutral units with a combined cost of 4 or more to research 1 technology.

abilities.name: Lunar Eclipse
abilities.description: When you perform a strategic action: You may exhaust this card. Return captured neutral units with a combined cost of 2 or more to gain 1 command token.

flagship.name: The Crypt
flagship.description: Once per action, when a Fighter is destroyed in a system containing or adjacent to this unit, place 1 Control Token on this card. Increase this unit's Capacity by 2 for each Control Token on this unit.

mech.name: Walking Mausoleum
mech.description: At the end of a round of ground combat, you may destroy 1 mech on that planet to destroy 2 of your opponent's Infantry on that planet.

faction_techs.name: Thanatocyte Lattice
faction_techs.description: Once per combat round, when a unit is destroyed, you may assign 1 hit to a unit of the same type as that destroyed unit.

faction_techs.name: Graveyard I
faction_techs.description: Once per action, if a unit in a system containing or adjacent to this unit is destroyed, gain 1 Commodity, or produce 1 unit of the same type in this system if able. Up to 4 Fighters in this system do not count against capacity.

faction_techs.name: Graveyard II
faction_techs.description: Once per action, if a unit in a system containing or adjacent to this unit is destroyed, gain 1 Commodity, and produce up to 1 unit of the same type in this system if able. Up to 8 Fighters in this system do not count against capacity. PRODUCTION 8.

promissory.name: Funeral Services
promissory.description: At the start of a round of combat, place this card face up in your play area. Each time a Fighter is destroyed during this combat, roll 1 die. For each result greater than 5, place that Fighter on this card. At the start of your next turn, place each Fighter from this card into systems that contain your ships. Then return this card to the Aeterna player.

agents.name: Morwen Deyth- Keeper of the Ledger of Loss
agents.description: ACTION: Select 1 player and exhaust this card. That player may destroy 1 non-fighter ship they control. Then, they may place 2 ships of different types from their reinforcements with combined cost up to the destroyed unit's cost +2 in that unit's system.

commanders.name: Vorun Kael - Mourning Marshal
commanders.description: Once per action, when you lose a combat, gain 1 Command Token.

heroes.name: Serapha Untar - Voice of the Tombs
heroes.description: At the start of a combat in a non-home non-Mecatol Rex system, you may destroy all of your ships in that system. Your opponent then destroys non-fighter ships in the active system with a combined cost equal to the combined cost of the non-fighter ships you destroyed. Then purge this card.

starting_techs.name: Aeterna Starting Tech
starting_techs.note: Choose up to 2 technologies with 0 prerequisites owned by no other player

starting_fleet.name: Aetern aStarting Fleet
starting_fleet.description: 1 Flagship, 1 Carrier, 4 Fighters, 1 Mech, 2 Infantry, 1 Space Dock, 1 PDS

breakthrough.name: Twilight Defense Systems
breakthrough.description: Planets that contain your space docks or mechs gain the unit abilities and ability text of your PDS units as if they were units. Other player's effects cannot make your units lose PLANETARY SHIELD.

abilities.name: Survivalists
abilities.description: You may treat your damaged units as Galvanized during combat.

abilities.name: Last Stand
abilities.description: During combat, when your last unit would be destroyed during the Assign Hits step, you may roll that unit's combat dice. For each result equal to or greater than that unit's combat value, produce 1 hit. If the last of your opponent's participating units are destroyed by this roll, that unit is not destroyed.

abilities.name: Rallying Cry
abilities.description: Systems that contain exactly 1 of your ships gain PRODUCTION 2 as if they were units.

planets.name: Ponthous
planets.legendary_ability: Fractured Souls: When you gain this card, place the Ponthous + and Ponthous – cards in your play area. The resource and influence value of Ponthous is equal to the number of readied Ponthous cards. When the Ponthous planet card is exhausted, you may exhaust this card and either Ponthous + or Ponthous – to ready Ponthous.

flagship.name: Old Glory
flagship.description: At the start of combat in this unit's system, you may damage this unit to give up to 2 Fighters in this system SUSTAIN DAMAGE until the end of that combat.

mech.name: Dragoons
mech.description: When this unit is destroyed during ground combat, you may pay 1 Resource to place 2 Infantry on this unit's planet.

faction_techs.name: Thunderbird Protocol
faction_techs.description: At the start of space combat involving your units, select 2 of your ground forces in that system. Those units participate in combat as if they were ships, and you may treat them as Galvanized until the end of that combat.

faction_techs.name: Renegade I
faction_techs.description: This unit can only transport infantry

faction_techs.name: Renegade II
faction_techs.description: This unit can only transport ground forces. When your opponent's units produce hits with ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE in this unit's system cancel 1 of those hits.

promissory.name: Thunderbird Prototype
promissory.description: At the start of space combat, select 1 of your ground forces in that system. That unit participates in combat as if it were a ship, and you may treat it as Galvanized until the end of that combat. Return this card to the Ponthous player at the end of that combat.

agents.name: General Caelyn - Front-Line Standard
agents.description: When a unit uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE during combat, you may exhaust this card. That player may place 2 Fighters and 2 Infantry in that system.

commanders.name: Marshal Faelorn - Voice of High Command
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Have a damaged unit on the game board.]
commanders.description: When you roll 1 or more dice, you may apply +2 to up to 2 of those dice.

heroes.name: Lyla Terras - Fallen Stars
heroes.description: ACTION: Choose 1 non-home non-legendary planet you control. Destroy all units on that planet, purge its attachments and its planet card. Produce hits on your opponent's non-fighter ships in an adjacent non-home system up to that planet's combined resource and influence value. Then place the destroyed planet token on that planet and purge this card.

starting_fleet.name: Ponthous Starting Fleet
starting_fleet.description: 1 Carrier, 2 Destroyers, 2 Fighters, 6 Infantry, 1 Space Dock

breakthrough.name: Self-Destruct Button
breakthrough.description: At the start of a combat, you may exhaust this card and destroy 1 non-fighter ship you control in that system. Produce hits equal to that unit's cost.
